entities.summary: Michael Creed is an Irish former Fine Gael politician who served as a Teachta Dála (TD) for the Cork North-West constituency from 2007 to 2024, and previously from 1989 to 2002. He served as Minister for Agriculture, Food and the Marine from 2016 to 2020.
